name: battery-theme
description: Firefox theme that reflects laptop battery state (extension + native messaging host)

scripts.sign: npx --yes web-ext@8 sign --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && npm run check:zip
scripts.check:shell: shellcheck install.sh host/mac/*.sh host/linux/*.sh userChrome/*.sh test/docker/*.sh test/fake-bin/* test/fake-bin-linux/* && for f in install.sh host/mac/*.sh host/linux/*.sh userChrome/*.sh; do /bin/bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:shell && npm run test:e2e
